d:
This was probably the most budget-friendly Trip in a European country for me. Thanks to the Deutschland Ticket or Germany's famous '49 Euro ticket'. Some Tourists could buy this ticket & could travel anywhere in using any public transport for a month, so yes, its possible to buy the 49 Euro ticket for Tourists as well. I travelled from Berlin to Sassnitz on a spontaneous trip and found a lot of things about Germany worth sharing.
